notes.title: New Gameplay Features and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
1. Add Challenge Mode and corresponding achievements

    Challenge Mode:
    At the start of the game, you can freely choose your team members, allowing a combination of up to 
    four characters. You cannot enter the Rebirth phase, and being defeated simply means the game ends. 
    The acquisition rates of Rebirth Crystals, Gold, Imprints, and Void Orbs are increased.

2. Modified the appearance of some NPCs.

3. Fixed some text errors and bugs.

notes.title: Bug fixes, feature adjustments, and adding Traditional Chinese version.
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue where a very small number of enemies were unable to use skills correctly.
2. Players can now choose whether to enable auto-battle during sweeping.
3. Added Traditional Chinese version.

notes.title: BUG fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused some levels to freeze when going back

notes.title: Update on August 11th
notes.content:
① Fixed the bug where entering the source world after clearing the Rank14 dungeon Lost Land caused it to freeze
② Reduced the sale of gold coins for some collectibles
